mock_data.title: Obituary
mock_data.passage:
The whole community has been saddened by the news of the death of Brian Peterson, who died suddenly last week after a short illness. Brian was well known to many of us in the town, but he was particularly well known in climbing circles and was regarded locally as the grand old man of rock-climbing.

As a young man, he took part in several major, and indeed dangerous, climbing expeditions, and cheated death on more than one occasion. He regarded it as a real feather in his cap that he was asked to take part in an Everest expedition in 1976 and welcomed the opportunity with open arms. The expedition was one of the major achievements of his climbing career and provided him with many anecdotes to which we all listened spellbound. A photograph of the expedition had pride of place on his mantelpiece.

Brian will also be remembered as a wonderful speaker and writer. He wrote many articles on climbing for a wide range of publications, but sadly never got round to writing any books on the subject, although this was always his intention. This is a great loss, as he was both an informative and an entertaining writer. However, who can blame him for wanting to spend time on the hills rather than spend it behind a typewriter?

Brian was a gifted writer, but it was as a speaker that he really came into his own. Whatever the nature of the audience, he made the subject of climbing come alive for them, illustrating his talks not only with marvellous slides, but also with personal anecdotes. He could hold any audience in the palm of his hand. Sometimes they would be on the edge of their seats at his stories and sometimes they would be rolling in the aisles. Not surprisingly, he was never short of speaking engagements.

Brian was an extremely active member of the local mountain rescue team until his illness. Although always willing to give a helping hand to people who got into difficulties in the mountains, he often got extremely angry with people who ventured on to the mountains without appropriate clothing or equipment and without leaving exact details of where they were going.

Brian was a devoted family man and is survived by his wife, Susan, and his sons, Michael and Graham, both of whom are experienced climbers and members of the mountain rescue team. We extend our sympathy to them.
mock_data.passageB1:
The community is very sad to hear that Brian Peterson has died. He died suddenly last week after being ill for a short time. Many people in the town knew Brian. He was especially famous in the climbing world and people thought of him as a very important and experienced climber.

When he was younger, Brian went on some big and dangerous climbing trips. He almost died more than once. He was very proud that he was asked to join a trip to Mount Everest in 1976. He was very happy to go. This trip was one of the most important things he did in his climbing career. He told many interesting stories about it, and we all loved listening to them. He had a photo of the trip in a special place in his house.

People will also remember Brian as a great speaker and writer. He wrote many articles about climbing for different magazines and newspapers. It's sad that he never wrote any books about climbing, even though he always wanted to. This is a pity because he was a very good writer who gave a lot of information and made people laugh. But we can understand why he wanted to spend time climbing mountains instead of writing at a computer.

Brian was a good writer, but he was even better as a speaker. It didn't matter who was listening, he made climbing interesting for them. He showed great pictures and told personal stories. He could control the audience completely. Sometimes his stories were so exciting that people were very nervous, and sometimes they were so funny that people laughed a lot. So, it's not surprising that he was always asked to speak.

Brian was a very active member of the local mountain rescue team until he became ill. He always wanted to help people who were in trouble on the mountains. But he often got very angry with people who went on the mountains without the right clothes or equipment, and without telling anyone where they were going. He felt it was irresponsible.

Brian loved his family very much. His wife, Susan, and his sons, Michael and Graham, are still alive. Both of his sons are experienced climbers and members of the mountain rescue team. We want to say that we are very sorry for their loss.
mock_data.passageB2:
It is with great sadness that the community learned of the passing of Brian Peterson, who died unexpectedly last week after a brief illness. Brian was a familiar face to many in town, but he was especially well-known within the climbing community, where he was widely regarded as a respected and experienced figure.

In his younger years, Brian participated in several significant and, indeed, perilous climbing expeditions, narrowly escaping death on more than one occasion. He considered it a great achievement to have been invited to join the Everest expedition in 1976, an opportunity he embraced wholeheartedly. This expedition marked a high point in his climbing career and provided him with countless stories that he shared with captivating detail. A photograph from the expedition held a prominent position on his mantelpiece.

Brian will also be remembered as a talented speaker and writer. He contributed numerous articles on climbing to various publications, but unfortunately, he never managed to write any books on the subject, despite it being a long-held ambition. This is a great pity, as he was both an informative and an engaging writer. However, it's easy to understand why he preferred spending time in the mountains to being chained to a typewriter.

While Brian was a capable writer, he truly excelled as a speaker. Regardless of the audience, he had a knack for making the world of climbing come alive, enhancing his talks not only with impressive slides but also with personal and often humorous anecdotes. He had the ability to captivate any audience. At times, listeners would be on the edge of their seats, gripped by his tales, and at others, they would be laughing uncontrollably. Unsurprisingly, he was always in high demand as a speaker.

Brian was a very active member of the local mountain rescue team until his illness. While always willing to lend a hand to those who found themselves in trouble in the mountains, he often expressed his frustration with individuals who ventured into the mountains without adequate clothing or equipment and without providing accurate information about their intended route. He believed strongly in responsible mountain access.

Above all, Brian was a devoted family man and is survived by his wife, Susan, and his sons, Michael and Graham, both of whom are experienced climbers and members of the mountain rescue team. We extend our deepest sympathies to them during this difficult time. Brian's legacy will live on.
mock_data.passageC1:
The community has been plunged into mourning following the untimely passing of Brian Peterson last week, succumbing to a brief illness. While Brian was a familiar face to many in town, he truly distinguished himself within the climbing fraternity, where he was revered as a local doyen of rock-climbing.

In his youth, Brian participated in several demanding and, indeed, perilous climbing expeditions, narrowly escaping death on more than one occasion. He held it as a badge of honour to have been invited to join an Everest expedition in 1976, an opportunity he embraced wholeheartedly. The expedition proved to be a crowning achievement of his climbing career, furnishing him with a wealth of captivating anecdotes that held listeners enthralled. A photograph commemorating the expedition occupied a position of prominence on his mantelpiece.

Brian will also be remembered as a gifted orator and writer. He contributed numerous articles on climbing to diverse publications, though he sadly never got around to authoring any books on the subject, despite it being a long-held ambition. This is a regrettable loss, given his capacity to be both informative and engaging in his writing. However, one can scarcely fault him for prioritising time spent scaling peaks over hours hunched over a typewriter.

While Brian possessed a natural flair for writing, it was as a public speaker that his talents truly came to the fore. Irrespective of the audience's background or expertise, he possessed the rare ability to bring the subject of climbing vividly to life, enriching his presentations not only with stunning visuals but also with compelling personal narratives. He could captivate any audience, at times leaving them on the edge of their seats with suspenseful tales, and at others, reduced to laughter by his humorous observations. Unsurprisingly, he was never wanting for speaking engagements.

Brian was an exceptionally active member of the local mountain rescue team until his illness took hold. While consistently willing to extend a helping hand to those who found themselves in precarious situations in the mountains, he would often express considerable frustration with individuals who ventured into the mountains lacking appropriate attire or equipment, and without providing precise details of their intended route. He believed strongly in due diligence when it came to mountain safety.

Brian was a devoted family man and leaves behind his wife, Susan, and his sons, Michael and Graham, both of whom are accomplished climbers and active members of the mountain rescue team, thereby carrying on his legacy. We extend our deepest condolences to them during this difficult time and trust that his spirit will live on.

questions.answer: An obituary is typically about someone who has died, including information about their life, achievements, personality, and the people they leave behind. It's expected to be a biographical tribute to a deceased local personality.
questions.question: From the title above, what do you expect the passage to be about?

questions.answer: Answers may vary. Common elements: the person's name and age, when/how they died, their accomplishments and career, personal qualities, hobbies and interests, family members who survive them, funeral arrangements, tributes from others, and a summary of their life's impact.
questions.question: In an obituary, what is usually said or written?

questions.answer: The passage is expected to be positive. Obituaries typically focus on the good qualities, achievements, and positive contributions of the deceased person. They are respectful tributes honoring the person's life and legacy.
questions.question: Do you think the passage will be positive or negative?

mock_data.translation:
Butun jamoatchilik Brian Petersonning o'limidan qayg'urmoqda, u o'tgan hafta qisqa kasallikdan keyin to'satdan vafot etdi. Brian ko'pchiligimizga tanish edi, ammo u ayniqsa toqqa chiqish doiralarida tanilgan va mahalliy darajada tosh-toqqa chiquvchilarning katta qariyi deb hisoblangan.

Yosh odam sifatida u bir nechta yirik va haqiqatan ham xavfli toqqa chiqish ekspeditsiyalarida qatnashgan va bir necha marta o'limdan qutulgan. U 1976 yilda Everest ekspeditsiyasida qatnashishga taklif qilinganini o'zining shlyapasidagi haqiqiy patga o'xshatib hisoblagan va imkoniyatni ochiq quchlar bilan qabul qilgan. Ekspeditsiya uning toqqa chiqish karerasining asosiy yutuqlaridan biri edi va unga biz hammamiz maftun bo'lib tinglaydigan ko'plab hikoyalar berdi. Ekspeditsiyaning fotosurati uning kaminining ustida faxrli o'ringa ega edi.

Brian shuningdek, ajoyib notiq va yozuvchi sifatida ham eslab qolinadi. U toqqa chiqish haqida ko'plab nashrlar uchun ko'plab maqolalar yozgan, ammo afsuski, bu mavzuda hech qachon kitob yozishga ulgurmagan, garchi bu doimo uning niyati bo'lgan. Bu katta yo'qotish, chunki u ham ma'lumotli, ham qiziqarli yozuvchi edi. Biroq, uni yozuv mashinkasi ortida vaqt o'tkazishdan ko'ra tepalikda vaqt o'tkazishni xohlash uchun kim ayblay oladi?

Brian iqtidorli yozuvchi edi, ammo u haqiqatan ham notiq sifatida o'zining eng yaxshi tomonini ko'rsatgan. Auditoriyaning tabiati qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, u ular uchun toqqa chiqish mavzusini jonlantirgan, ma'ruzalarini nafaqat ajoyib slaydlar bilan, balki shaxsiy hikoyalar bilan ham tasvirlagan. U har qanday auditoriyani o'z qo'lining kaftida ushlab turishi mumkin edi. Ba'zan ular uning hikoyalaridan kursining chetida o'tirishardi va ba'zan ular yo'laklarda dumalab ketishardi. Ajablanarlisi shuki, u hech qachon nutq so'zlash takliflaridan kam emas edi.

Brian kasalligiga qadar mahalliy tog'larni qutqarish guruhining juda faol a'zosi edi. Tog'larda qiyinchiliklarga duch kelgan odamlarga doimo yordam berishga tayyor bo'lsa-da, u ko'pincha mos kiyim yoki asbob-uskunasiz va qayerga ketayotganliklari haqida aniq ma'lumot qoldirmasdan tog'larga qo'rqmasdan borgan odamlarga juda g'azablanardi.

Brian sadoqatli oilaviy odam edi va uning rafiqasi Syuzan va o'g'illari Maykl va Grehem hayotda qoldilar, ularning ikkalasi ham tajribali alpinistlar va tog'larni qutqarish guruhining a'zolaridir. Biz ularga hamdardligimizni bildiramiz.

Jamiyat Brayan Petersonning vafot etgani haqidagi xabarni katta qayg‘u bilan qabul qildi. U o‘tgan hafta qisqa muddatli kasallikdan so‘ng to‘satdan vafot etdi. Shahardagi ko‘pchilik Brayanni tanirdi. U ayniqsa tog‘ga chiqish olamida mashhur edi va odamlar uni juda muhim va tajribali alpinist deb bilishardi.

Brayan yoshligida bir nechta katta va xavfli tog‘ga chiqish safarlariga borgan. U bir necha marta o‘lim yoqasidan qaytgan. U 1976-yilda Everest tog‘iga bo‘ladigan sayohatga qo‘shilish taklifini olganidan juda faxrlanardi. Borishdan juda xursand edi. Bu sayohat uning alpinizm faoliyatidagi eng muhim voqealardan biri edi. U bu haqda ko'plab qiziqarli hikoyalar aytib berardi va biz hammamiz ularni tinglashni yaxshi ko'rardik. Uning uyida ushbu sayohatning fotosurati maxsus joyda saqlanardi.

Odamlar Brayanni ajoyib notiq va yozuvchi sifatida ham eslashadi. U turli xil jurnal va gazetalarda tog‘ga chiqish haqida ko‘plab maqolalar yozgan. Afsuski, u hech qachon tog‘ga chiqish haqida kitob yozmagan, garchi u har doim xohlagan bo‘lsa ham. Bu achinarli, chunki u juda yaxshi yozuvchi edi, ko‘plab ma’lumot berardi va odamlarni kuldirardi. Ammo nima uchun u kompyuterda yozish o'rniga tog‘larga chiqishga vaqt sarflashni xohlaganini tushunishimiz mumkin.

Brayan yaxshi yozuvchi edi, lekin u notiq sifatida undan ham yaxshiroq edi. Kim tinglayotgani muhim emasdi, u tog‘ga chiqishni ular uchun qiziqarli qilib qo‘yardi. U ajoyib rasmlar ko‘rsatdi va shaxsiy hikoyalarini aytib berdi. U tomoshabinlarni butunlay nazorat qila olardi. Ba’zan uning hikoyalari shunchalik hayajonli ediki, odamlar juda asabiylashardi, ba’zan esa shunchalik kulgili ediki, odamlar ko‘p kulishardi. Shunday ekan, uning doim nutq so‘zlashga taklif qilinishi ajablanarli emas.

Brayan kasal bo'lib qolguniga qadar mahalliy tog‘ qutqaruv jamoasining juda faol a’zosi edi. U har doim tog‘larda muammoga duch kelgan odamlarga yordam berishni xohlardi. Ammo u ko‘pincha tog‘ga to‘g‘ri kiyim yoki jihozsiz va qayerga ketayotganini hech kimga aytmasdan chiqqan odamlardan juda jahli chiqardi. U buni mas'uliyatsizlik deb hisoblardi.

Brayan oilasini juda yaxshi ko‘rardi. Uning rafiqasi Syuzan va o‘g‘illari Maykl va Grem hali ham hayot. Uning ikkala o‘g‘li ham tajribali alpinistlar va tog‘ qutqaruv jamoasi a’zolari. Ularning yo‘qotishi uchun juda qayg‘udamiz.
mock_data.translationB2:
Jamiyat o'tgan hafta kutilmaganda qisqa muddatli kasallikdan so'ng vafot etgan Brayan Petersonning vafoti haqidagi xabarni katta qayg'u bilan qabul qildi. Brayan shaharning ko'plab aholisi uchun tanish yuz edi, lekin u ayniqsa alpinizm hamjamiyatida yaxshi tanilgan bo'lib, u yerda keng e'tirof etilgan hurmatli va tajribali shaxs sifatida qadrlanardi.

Yoshligida Brayan bir nechta muhim va, aslida, xavfli alpinizm ekspeditsiyalarida ishtirok etgan, bir necha marta o'limdan arang qutulgan. U 1976-yilda Everest ekspeditsiyasiga taklif qilinganini katta muvaffaqiyat deb hisobladi va bu imkoniyatni butun qalbi bilan qabul qildi. Bu ekspeditsiya uning alpinizm faoliyatidagi eng yuqori nuqtani belgilab berdi va unga nihoyatda jozibali tafsilotlar bilan baham ko'rgan ko'plab hikoyalarni taqdim etdi. Ekspeditsiyadan olingan fotosurat uning tokchasida ko'zga ko'rinarli joy egallagan edi.

Brayan iste'dodli notiq va yozuvchi sifatida ham yodda qoladi. U turli nashrlarga alpinizm bo'yicha ko'plab maqolalar yozgan, ammo afsuski, uzoq yillik orzusi bo'lishiga qaramay, bu mavzuda hech qanday kitob yozishga erisha olmadi. Bu juda achinarli, chunki u ham ma'lumot beruvchi, ham qiziqarli yozuvchi edi. Biroq, uning nima uchun tog'larda vaqt o'tkazishni yozuv mashinasiga bog'lanib qolishdan afzal ko'rganini tushunish oson.

Brayan qobiliyatli yozuvchi bo'lsa-da, u haqiqatan ham notiq sifatida ustun edi. U tinglovchilar kim bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, alpinizm dunyosini jonlantirish, o'z nutqlarini nafaqat ta'sirchan slaydlar, balki shaxsiy va ko'pincha hazilomuz hikoyalar bilan boyitish qobiliyatiga ega edi. U har qanday auditoriyani mahliyo qila olardi. Ba'zan tinglovchilar uning hikoyalariga berilib, o'rindiqlarining chetiga o'tirib qolishsa, ba'zida esa nazoratdan tashqari kulishardi. Ajablanarlisi yo'qki, u har doim notiq sifatida katta talabga ega edi.

Brayan kasalligiga qadar mahalliy tog' qutqaruv guruhining juda faol a'zosi edi. Tog'larda muammoga duch kelganlarga har doim yordam berishga tayyor bo'lsa-da, u ko'pincha yetarli kiyim yoki jihozlarsiz va mo'ljallangan yo'nalishlari haqida aniq ma'lumot bermasdan tog'larga yo'l olgan shaxslardan noroziligini bildirardi. U mas'uliyatli tog'dan foydalanishga qat'iy ishongan.

Hammasidan ham ko'proq, Brayan sadoqatli oila boshlig'i edi va ortidan rafiqasi Syuzan va o'g'illari Maykl va Graham qoldilar, ularning ikkalasi ham tajribali alpinistlar va tog' qutqaruv guruhining a'zolari. Ushbu qiyin paytda ularga chuqur hamdardligimizni bildiramiz. Brayanning merosi yashaydi.
